description: Open/route/close smoke on Pharo 13. Kept beside the Pharo 14 profile for deep checkout paths: Pharo's VM loads a module by absolute path through a 256-byte buffer, and Pharo 13's libgit2.dylib is ten characters shorter than Pharo 14's libgit2-1.9.1.9.0.dylib, which is enough to decide it. Prefer the Pharo 14 profile and a short --launcherProfileRoot.
